customer.tagline: Koreyadagi maishiy xizmatlar o'z tilingizda qulay
customer.helperMasterBanner: A'lo mahorat va tajribaga (Know-how) ega mahalliy maishiy yordam ustalari, iltimos bu yerda ro'yxatdan o'ting

tech.title: Ustalar uchun xizmat
tech.headline: LIFE.HELP malakali mutaxassislarni hamkorlikka chorlaydi.
tech.subheadline: Telefon raqami orqali oson ro'yxatdan o'ting, komissiya shartnomasini imzolang va moslashuvchan ishlang.
tech.signInDesc: Mobil telefon raqamingizni tasdiqlash orqali tizimga oson kiring.

privacy.title: Maxfiylikni himoya qilish
privacy.content: Mijozlarimiz xavfsizligi uchun ism, manzil va telefon raqamingiz tizimda alohida saqlanmaydi. Telefon raqamingiz ustaga 050 bilan boshlanuvchi vaqtinchalik raqam sifatida beriladi va bir haftadan so'ng bekor qilinadi. Xizmat tarixi faqat sizning qurilmangizda saqlanadi.

request.title: Xizmatga ariza berish
request.problemPlaceholder: Masalan: Hojatxonada suv ketmayapti va ko'tarilmoqda.
request.photosHint: Rasmlar ustaga vaziyatni tezroq tushunishga yordam beradi.
request.housingPlaceholder: Masalan: Garov puli 3-5 mln, oylik to'lovi 350-450 ming vonlik jihozlangan bir yoki ikki xonali uy.
request.housingRegionPlaceholder: Istalgan hudud yoki mahalla nomini yozing

serviceDetail.needService: Agar sizga ushbu xizmat kerak bo'lsa, ariza yuboring.
serviceDetail.applyDesc: Muammoni tasvirlab rasm yuboring, yaqin atrofdagi ustani ulab beramiz.

serviceProblems.toilet: Hojatxona suvi ketmayapti va ko'tarilib ketyapti.
serviceProblems.sink: Oshxona rakovinasidan suv sekin ketyapti va hid kelyapti.
serviceProblems.drain: Vanna polidagi quvur tiqilib, suv to'planib qoldi.
serviceProblems.leak: Shift yoki devordan suv tommoqda va oboy ho'l bo'lmoqda.
serviceProblems.detection: Suv puli kutilmaganda ko'p keldi va pastki qavatdagilar suv oqyapti deyapti.
serviceProblems.water: Kran to'liq yopilmayapti, tommoqda yoki zanglagan suv kelyapti.
serviceProblems.plumbing: Rakovina ostidagi quvur yorilib, polga suv oqmoqda.
serviceProblems.boiler: Boylerda xatolik kodi yonmoqda, issiq suv va isitish ishlamayapti.
serviceProblems.cleaning: Ko'chib kirishdan oldin tozalash yoki oshxona/hammomni chuqur tozalash kerak.
serviceProblems.housing: Jihozlangan bir xonali yoki ikki xonali qulay uy kerak.

chat.title: Koreyadagi maishiy xizmatlar o'z tilingizda qulay Live Chat
chat.tag: 1:1 Live Professional Consultation in Native Language
chat.desc: Fast and friendly native language consultation service for foreign residents in Korea.
chat.allDutyNotice: {count} total counselors on duty. Leave a message and you will be connected immediately.
chat.startDesc: Describe your inquiry in your preferred language, and an expert counselor will be assigned immediately.
chat.langHint: Can be changed in the top right language menu
chat.inquiryLabel: Inquiry Details or Living Assistance Needed
chat.inquiryPlaceholder: e.g., Blocked drainage needing urgent plumber / Housing lease contract / Boiler repair
chat.guide1: Covers all living issues in Korea: plumbing, repair, house hunting, cleaning, etc.
chat.guide2: Communicate comfortably in your native language.
chat.guide3: Directly match with verified master helpers in your local area.
chat.counselorRecruit: Are you a professional multilingual counselor?
chat.counselorRecruitDesc: Register easily with your mobile number to start counseling foreign residents.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Type your message in English or Korean...
chat.closedNotice: This consultation has ended. Please start a new session for further inquiries.
chat.loginDesc: Receive an SMS verification code with your phone number and begin your shift immediately.
chat.registerDesc: Register your profile and languages to get instantly verified and start taking shifts.
chat.counselorNamePlaceholder: e.g., John Miller, Nguyen Thi Huong, Wang Wei
chat.specialtyPlaceholder: e.g., 3 years living interpretation, TOPIK Level 6, Real estate specialist
chat.agreeLabel: I agree to counselor operational regulations and privacy policy.
chat.emptyWorkspace: Chapdagi ro'yxatdan faol chatni tanlang yoki navbatdagi murojaatni qabul qiling.
chat.emptyWorkspaceSub: Mijozlarning ona tilida savollarga javob bering va kerakli xizmatlarni bog'lang.
chat.quickHelloText: Assalomu alaykum! Men LIFE.HELP mutaxassisiman. Sizga qanday yordam bera olaman?
chat.quickTechText: Manzilingiz tasdiqlandi. Yaqin atrofdagi malakali mutaxassisimizni darhol yuboramiz.
chat.quickHousingText: Uy topish va ijara shartnomasini tuzish bo'yicha muhim qoidalarni batafsil tushuntirib beraman.

workspace.title: Yordamchi ish maydoni
workspace.descActive: Mijozlardan buyurtma tushganda darhol bog'lanish mumkin. Dam olish vaqtida tugmani bosib tanaffusga o'ting.
workspace.descPaused: Hozirda buyurtmalar qabuli to'xtatilgan. Ishga tayyor bo'lganingizda tugmani yoqing.
workspace.hotlineTitle: Tizim holati o'zgarishini bildirish ishonch telefoni
workspace.hotlineDesc: Ilovaga kirish qiyin bo'lsa yoki shoshilinch o'zgarishlar yuz bersa (chiqolmaslik, hudud o'zgarishi, favqulodda holat), darhol bog'laning.
workspace.servicesDesc: Bajara olmaydigan xizmatlarni o'chirish yoki yangi yo'nalishlarni darhol qo'shish uchun bosing.
workspace.regionsDesc: Bora olmaydigan hududlarni ✕ tugmasi bilan o'chiring va yangi hududlarni qo'shing.
workspace.contractClauseTitle: Majburiyat va o'zgarishlarni xabardor qilish sharti
workspace.contractClauseDesc: Yordamchi vaqtincha ishlay olmaganda yoki xizmat sohasi, hudud o'zgarganda ilova yoki telefon raqamlari (010-5757-5757 / 010-5959-5959) orqali darhol xabar berish majburiyatini oladi.
workspace.minServiceAlert: Kamida bitta xizmat turi saqlanishi kerak.
workspace.minRegionAlert: Kamida bitta hudud belgilangan bo'lishi kerak.

payment.title: To'lov va bank orqali o'tkazma
payment.subtitle: Xizmatni xavfsiz va tezkor ko'rsatish uchun quyidagi hisob raqamiga to'lovni o'tkazing.
payment.bankTransferInstruction: Iltimos, Woori Bank 1002-080-001919 hisobiga pul o'tkazing
payment.notice1: Tezkor tasdiqlash uchun to'lovchi nomiga ismingizni yoki telefon raqamingizning oxirgi 4 ta raqamini yozing.
payment.notice2: To'lov tasdiqlangach, darhol sizga mutaxassis usta biriktiriladi va bildirishnoma yuboriladi.
payment.notice3: To'lovni tasdiqlash bo'yicha savollaringiz bo'lsa, onlayn maslahat xizmatimizga murojaat qiling.

review.title: Mijozning erkin fikri
review.subtitle: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni kiritmasdan o'z fikringizni erkin qoldiring. Sharhingiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri administrator elektron pochtasiga (contact@life.help) yuboriladi.
review.contentPlaceholder: Xizmat, usta yoki maslahatchi haqidagi taassurotlaringiz bilan erkin bo'lishing. (Ism, telefon raqami kiritish shart emas.)
review.emailNotice: 📧 Ushbu sharh administrator elektron pochtasiga (contact@life.help) xavfsiz yetkaziladi.
review.successDesc: Qimmatli fikringiz administrator pochtasiga (contact@life.help) yetkazildi. Rahmat!
